name: I Am the One Who Knocks: Say the Famous Line With Your Own Face
blurb: The I am the one who knocks meme is a calm, cold speech from a 2011 TV drama scene, quoted for fifteen years.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
The viral "I am the one who knocks" meme, made from [Image 1]: a tense, slow-burn TV drama scene at night, photorealistic and cinematic, vertical 9:16, one continuous take with no cuts.

Use [Image 1] as identity reference. Place the speaker in a dim bedroom doorway, delivering the two lines below with a steady gaze and one restrained hand gesture. A fictional adult listener sits on the edge of the bed in the foreground, seen from behind: only the back of the head and one shoulder show, soft and out of focus at the lower edge of the frame, and the listener's face never shows. Use warm bedside light, cool window light, a slow push-in, consistent faces, natural hands, and no violence.

THE SPEAKER is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), so their friends recognize them at once. The face stays the same from the first frame to the last, also while they speak. Never morph. They keep the hair and the clothes from [Image 1]. No hat of any kind, and no beard, goatee, moustache or glasses unless [Image 1] shows them. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the speaker is that animal with its own face, fur and markings, sitting in the doorway, and the lines come as a deep voice-over.

0-2 s: a medium shot from the chest up. THE SPEAKER stands still in the doorway, the dark hallway behind, warm lamp light on one side of the face and cool blue moonlight on the other. Silent, they look down at the listener, just past the lens, with a calm, cold stare. The camera starts a very slow push-in.
2-5.5 s: in a low, quiet, even voice, without blinking, THE SPEAKER says: "I am not in danger. I am the danger."
5.5-6.5 s: a beat of silence. One restrained hand gesture: one hand rises a little, palm open, then lowers.
6.5-9 s: THE SPEAKER leans in slightly and says slowly, each word weighted: "I am the one who knocks."
9-10 s: silence. Lips closed, a cold, steady stare. The push-in ends on a close-up of the face, large and sharp.

Audio: only THE SPEAKER's voice, calm, low and cold, a new voice that fits the face in [Image 1], never imitating a real actor's voice. Each line said once, in sync with the lips. A faint room tone and a low, tense drone under it. No background music. The listener never speaks.

Exactly two people: the speaker and the listener seen from behind. No weapons, no touching, no violence. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no TV channel badge. Five fingers on each hand.

A cinematic, photorealistic film still at night, vertical 9:16: the pet sits upright in the open doorway of a dim bedroom, framed by the door frame, the dark hallway behind it. Warm light from a bedside lamp falls on one side of its face, cool blue moonlight from a window on the other. In the soft-focus foreground at the lower edge, the corner of a neatly made bed. The camera is at the pet's eye level. The whole pet is in frame, its face large and sharp, looking straight into the camera with a calm, cold, unblinking stare, its mouth closed. Exactly one animal, with its natural body. No people, no clothes, no hat, no text, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.text: Keep the animal's face, fur, markings and body, the doorway and the light exactly as in the image. A tense, slow-burn TV drama scene at night in one continuous shot: the camera pushes in very slowly from the whole pet to a close-up of its face. The pet stays still in the doorway and stares straight into the lens with a calm, cold look. Its mouth stays closed the whole time: it never talks; only the voice-over speaks. 0-2 s: silence, the cold stare. 2-5.5 s: a deep, calm, quiet voice-over says: "I am not in danger. I am the danger." 5.5-6.5 s: the pet slowly narrows its eyes. 6.5-9 s: the voice-over says slowly, each word weighted: "I am the one who knocks." 9-10 s: the pet tilts its head a little and holds the stare. Audio: only the voice-over, a new voice, never imitating a real actor's voice, each line said once; a faint room tone and a low, tense drone; no background music, no meow, no bark. Exactly one animal. No people, no extra limbs, no morphing, no cuts, no text, no subtitles, no logos.
